events.title: Research Experience for High School Students (REHS)
events.eligibility: Southern California residents; completed most recent semester of high school; in grade 10, 11 or 12 at public or private high school or homeschool; at least 16 years old on or before June 15; minimum 3.0 cumulative GPA; college bound; one year high school chemistry or biology recommended; specific project prerequisites vary; mandatory attendance at Poster Session on July 31, 2026
